text:
chris: FYI saw a sharp p95 bump (~2x) on inference-prod starting at 11:43 UTC. Suspect it lines up with the policy flip in last deploy (LRU -> FIFO). Rolling back the policy now :grimacing:

deploy-bot: deployed commit 0f3a7c - runtime:kv-evict-policy=fifo -> applied by @chris at 2026-03-17T11:42:58Z :rocket:

maya: Ugh. Can you paste the short perf sample + evict metrics? Also which model/seq length was the hot path?

chris: quick paste from metrics around the window:
```
p50: 12ms p95: 240ms p99: 420ms
kv.evictions/s: 4300 -> spike
kv.page_faults/s: 1200
runtime.requests/s: steady 350
hot_model: gpt-medium-8k, avg_seq: 2500
```

ravi: Interesting that evictions/s jumps while throughput stays flat. FIFO will reinsert older segments and cause extra paging churn under long-context workloads. We saw similar behavior in stress harness but thought it was edge-case.

sara: Can we repro quickly on staging? If FIFO causes reinsert chains, that can cause synchronous IO stalls on the pager path which would explain p95 blips.

lee: Triggered a staging run with same traffic shape (seq distribution skewed to long contexts). I also ran perf map; attaching the hottest stacks (summarized):
```
kvcache::pager::handle_page_fault
kvcache::evict::reinsert_chain
runtime::vfs::read_block_sync
kern::alloc::dealloc
```

maya: Thanks. That stack matches synchronous reinsert work blocking the serving thread. Two action items: (1) revert FIFO experiment on prod now (chris), (2) add tracing around reinsert latency + a counter for reinsert_chain length (ravi).

chris: Done, rolled policy back to LRU at 11:46 UTC. p95 already trending down in the last minute :thumbsup:

ravi: I'll open a small perf PR to add chain length histogram and to make reinsert async+bounded so it can't stall the hot path. Also propose a canary config that only flips to FIFO for short-context workloads.

maya: Sounds good. Also add a slowlog that records when reinsert_count > 5 for a single eviction op. That will help diagnose in prod without full tracing.

chris: leaving notes in the incident thread. Thanks all :eyes:

sara: Once Ravi has a patch, let's run the staging replay and validate p95 under long contexts. If green, we can consider an improved FIFO variant but guarded by context-length thresholds.
